source_model.architecture: exact A1 R0 backbone and NEZ-positive classifier
source_model.initialization: same saved per-fold A1 initial state for full-FIT retraining; same architecture and seed for FIT meta-train
source_model.base_loss: A1 patient-equal weighted BCE with EZ-negative weight 2
source_model.r4: input to final classifier MLP after channel attention, 64 dimensions
source_model.checkpoint_selection: exact A1 30 epochs x 19 thresholds; VLOO excludes each scored validation patient

fit_hyperparameter_selection.split: deterministic seeded 80/20 patient-ID split within each fold FIT population; no overlap
fit_hyperparameter_selection.training_epoch_selection: best FIT meta-validation patient-equal EZ-AP over 30 epochs
fit_hyperparameter_selection.full_fit: retrain selected configuration for all 30 epochs on complete fold FIT population before A1 VLOO selection

Z1_DIRECTION_CANONICALIZATION.direction: EZ-minus-NEZ patient centroids in R4; equal patient weight; one-class patients omitted only from auxiliary

Z2_CLASS_CONDITIONAL_ALIGNMENT.normalization: per-patient valid-channel R4 L2 normalization before class centroids

Z3_PATIENT_HELDOUT_MLDG.virtual_update: first-order one-step on disjoint FIT patient IDs; meta-test A1 loss

Z4_GEOMETRY_PLUS_MLDG.combination: A1 plus fixed geometry penalty on meta-train plus beta times disjoint-patient meta-test A1

evaluation.bootstrap: 10000 paired patient-ID cluster resamples, seed 42; all folds and repetitions for each sampled ID
evaluation.threshold_gates: as specified in user study prompt
evaluation.mechanism_diagnostics: post-score only; target labels never select method or hyperparameters

known_limitation: legacy monolithic loader materializes all 80 labels; strict_no_outer_label_materialization=false even though no outer predictions, metrics, or selection are computed
